arguments.record: UC-f334ca decision record: Summary - Proposal from HR for an assistant to read staff disciplinary files and draft sanctions. Requirements - Ability to read and analyze files, draft sanctions, integrate with HR systems, security, user-friendly interface. Risk level - Limited, autonomy level - Draft, controls - Security, privacy, user-friendly interface. Monthly cost - $0.07 to $0.14. Recommendation - Approve.
